subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and course of action carefully. Decide which of the following courses of action logically follows the statement?

Statement:

The weather bureau has released the weather forecast for Kashmir for the next week, in which they have said that there is going to be heavy snowfall throughout the week.

Courses:

I. The weather bureau should broadcast this information throughout Kashmir through various means.

II. The municipal bodies should make arrangements to clear the snow from the roads.

III. This news should be prevented from spreading outside the state.

options.text: Only courses of action (II) and (III) follow.
All the courses of action (I), (II) and (III) follow.
Only courses of action (I) and (II) follow.
